Message:
Although we still lived
among the poor,
we couldn’t have
been any happier.
Until my brother fell ill, that is.

Any kind of medicine
would have eased his pain...
but I couldn’t afford
anything like that...

If I had money, I could save him...
If only... If only I had money...!

“Oh God, I’ll give you anything—
no, everything I have.

Just please...save him!
Save my brother!”
“Very well. I shall help you.”

A voice suddenly made
its way inside my head.

“You shall have the power
to turn your memories into riches.
The more precious
the memories you offer,
the greater the riches
you will attain.”

Could it be?
Did God hear my prayer?
But, if I offer up my memories,
that means...

The day my little brother
spoke his first word...
The first time
we cooked together...
I remember everything.

They’re all precious to me.
I don’t wanna lose any of them...!
“B-Big...Sis...”

My brother’s voice
was weak and faint.
His hands, cold as ice...

At this rate,
he won’t even make it
through the night...!
I’ll do it...!

The moment I made my choice,
God’s holy mark emerged
on my left hand.

“Now, call to your mind
a memory you wish to offer.”

As God’s voice guided me,
memories of my childhood
came into view.

Then, countless jewels appeared
in the palm of my hand...

Incredible...!
This is enough
to save my brother.
Thank you, God!
